persons.name: Bora Özkent
persons.digest:
According to Bora Özkent, the Nasdaq failed to clear its 50-day average and gains on low volume should not be taken too seriously; the Elice IPO loss in Korea and **CoreWeave** credit worries are weighing on AI stocks. He says the market will swing up and down until the war and the elections are over but he sees no problem in the fundamentals; he adds that positive Iran-US news could turn things around quickly.

This is earnings week: **Netflix** and **SpaceX** report tonight, **Tesla** and **Meta** tomorrow. He says he holds **Meta** and **Tesla**, and that **Amazon** jumped 5% on Morgan Stanley's $350 target. Anthropic's IPO is due in November, and he reads **Anthropic**'s plan to set aside 5% of its shares in a fund and Musk's SpaceX share gift as a hedge against an AI-unemployment backlash.

items.title: Nasdaq Süründürmeye Devam Ediyor
items.summary: Bora Özkent says the Nasdaq stayed below its 50-day average and that rallies on low volume should not be taken seriously. The Elice IPO drop and rising CoreWeave credit risk premiums are weighing on AI stocks. S&P 500 forward earnings expectations are up 31% while the index is up 12.3% year to date; tech earnings expectations are up 65.5% against a 23% price gain, so forward P/E is falling. Amazon rose 5% on Morgan Stanley's $350 target and Tesla rose 4% on an Ark Invest scenario. Netflix, SpaceX, Tesla, Meta, Nokia and Bloom Energy report this week. He says the market will swing until the war and elections end, that his portfolio is about 12% below its peak but he sees no fundamental problem, and that Iran-US peace could trigger a big rally.
